title: fix(gen): deploy Portkey with every Vertex system message kept
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Pins the gateway to pollinations/gateway#14 (`9ffc0ef17e`)
- Fix: Gemini on Vertex got only `messages[0]` as its system instruction (first text part only). Every later system message was dropped silently.
- Live before: `google/gemini-3-flash-preview` with two system messages followed only the first; eight other providers followed both
- Deploys with the next `main` → `production` promotion (`Deploy / Portkey gateway` runs when this script changes on `production`)

Found while reviewing #16362.

gist.headline: Gemini gets the whole note
gist.blurb: Two system messages went in; Gemini on Vertex read one. The gateway fix keeps the whole set together.
gist.summary: Pins the Portkey gateway to pollinations/gateway#14 so Gemini on Vertex receives every system message, rather than only the first text part of messages[0].
gist.impact: Requests to google/gemini-3-flash-preview with two system messages will follow both instructions, matching the behavior observed across eight other providers.
